functions.name: PiecewiseFunctionEval
functions.summary: Evaluates a two-input piecewise function from 15 coefficient fields of `this`. The a3 input selects one of three linear segments by sign and threshold (this[1..8]), the result is combined as a2 * this[0] + v3, then a boundary correction is applied when the a2 excess v5 over the boundary window (this[13], this[14]) is positive, using two correction lines (this[9..12]). Returns the corrected result, or the unmodified result when no correction applies.

operations.description: Segment selection on the a3 sign: branch on a3 <= 0.0 (zero reference dbl_59E430).
For non-positive a3, select the high-magnitude segment when a3 >= this[7] (threshold offset 0x38).
v3 = a3 * this[6] (offset 0x30): high-magnitude negative segment, slope only.
v3 = a3 * this[5] + this[8] (offsets 0x28, 0x40): low-magnitude negative segment, slope plus intercept.
For positive a3, select the low segment when a3 <= this[3] (threshold offset 0x18).
v3 = a3 * this[2] (offset 0x10): low positive segment, slope only.
v3 = a3 * this[1] + this[4] (offsets 0x8, 0x20): high positive segment, slope plus intercept.
result = a2 * this[0] (offset 0x0) + v3: combine the a2 scale term with the selected segment value.
Boundary selection: when a2 <= this[14] (offset 0x70) compute the excess against the upper boundary.
v5 = this[14] - a2 (offset 0x70).
Otherwise v5 = a2 - this[13] (offset 0x68): excess beyond the lower boundary.
Correction is attempted only when v5 > 0.0 (zero reference dbl_59E430).
v6 = v5 * this[10] + this[9] (offsets 0x50, 0x48): first boundary-correction line.
v7 = v5 * this[12] + this[11] (offsets 0x60, 0x58): second boundary-correction line.
Sign split of the correction on a2 <= 0.0 (zero reference dbl_59E430).
v9 = v7 * a3 - v6 * v5: correction value for the non-positive a2 side.
Apply the negative-side correction only when v9 < 0.0 (zero reference dbl_59E430).
return result + v9 (corrected value, negative side).
v8 = v5 * v6 + v7 * a3: correction value for the positive a2 side.
Apply the positive-side correction only when v8 > 0.0 (zero reference dbl_59E430).
return result + v8 (corrected value, positive side).
Fallback return of the unmodified result when no correction applies.
